Asset type: one production arena trophy currency icon for Sylve, a premium hand-painted 2D woodland fantasy card game.
Primary request: a single small golden trophy cup with two graceful curved handles shaped like oak twigs, a broad bowl with an embossed oak leaf, and a short sturdy dark walnut-and-gold pedestal. The trophy must have a compact clear silhouette readable at 24 pixels.

Constraints: genuine alpha-transparent background. No scenery, ground, frame, letters, numbers, text, logo, watermark, extra objects or painted checkerboard.
